style.summary: clean flat vector-style scientific illustration with soft pastel fills, friendly and refined, like a polished academic overview figure
style.line: one uniform thin dark navy outline (#1F2937), identical weight on every element
style.shading: flat fills with one soft shadow tone, light from the upper left, no gradients

sheet_rules: All elements are small icons in the same drawn style, same outline weight and same palette, as if drawn by one illustrator for a journal figure. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere in any element.

elements.label: Human researcher
elements.description: a friendly researcher shown from the chest up, short dark hair, round glasses, light blue shirt, calm smile, facing the viewer

elements.label: AI agent
elements.description: a friendly rounded robot with a round head, two eyes, small antenna and headphones, white and light blue body, raising one hand

elements.label: Sub-agents
elements.description: two small rounded robots standing side by side, one slightly smaller, teal and light blue bodies, simple faces

elements.label: Recorded sessions
elements.description: a stack of two paper pages with a speech bubble resting on the top page, as a recorded conversation transcript, abstract grey lines instead of letters

elements.label: Tag
elements.description: a classic luggage-style label tag with a punched hole and a short string loop, pale orange fill with a darker orange band

elements.label: Independent coders
elements.description: two small robot heads of different shape facing each other with a magnifying glass between them, light blue and teal

elements.label: Knowledge
elements.description: an open book with two stacked closed books under it and a small bookmark ribbon, blue covers and cream pages

elements.label: Proposal
elements.description: a blueprint-style drawing sheet with a simple sketched diagram of boxes and lines, a pencil and a triangular set square lying on it, green accents

elements.label: Decision
elements.description: a wooden signpost with two board signs pointing in opposite directions and a round green check-mark stamp on one board, orange boards

elements.label: Metacognition
elements.description: a magnifying glass held over a checklist clipboard with three tick boxes, and a small gear beside it, blue and teal tones

elements.label: Execution
elements.description: one large gear with a wrench crossing it, grey and light blue metal tones

elements.label: Mixed contribution
elements.description: two interlocking gears, one light blue and one orange, meshing together

elements.label: Existence
elements.description: a magnifying glass over a small cluster of three dots, with a green check-mark badge at the corner

elements.label: Distribution
elements.description: a small bar chart with four bars of different heights in blue, teal, orange and green and a baseline, no axis labels

elements.label: Transition
elements.description: a small network of four circular nodes joined by straight lines in a loop shape, two nodes blue and two orange, lines without arrowheads

elements.label: Exchange
elements.description: two overlapping speech bubbles, one light blue and one orange, each with three small dots inside
